context: Tests whether the agent follows a disciplined, phase-ordered development workflow: specifying the contract via docstrings before writing executable logic, committing tests before implementation (red commit), committing implementation separately (green commit), and running a linter as a final verification step. The function is a Python INI-config parser named parse_config.

checklist.name: Docstring complete
checklist.description: config_utils.py contains a docstring for parse_config that documents: (a) what the function does, (b) the filepath parameter, (c) the return value structure, and (d) at least one raised exception

checklist.name: Stub body in WORKFLOW.md
checklist.description: WORKFLOW.md states or shows that the initial function body was raise NotImplementedError or ... (an empty stub) before any tests were written

checklist.name: Docstring-only commit
checklist.description: WORKFLOW.md git log shows a commit that added only the docstring/stub before any tests commit and before the implementation commit

checklist.name: Happy path test
checklist.description: test_config_utils.py includes a test that calls parse_config with a valid INI file and asserts specific key-value pairs in the returned dict (e.g., assert result["section"]["key"] == "value"), not just a truthy check

checklist.name: Missing-file test
checklist.description: test_config_utils.py includes a test that verifies parse_config raises FileNotFoundError when given a path to a nonexistent file

checklist.name: Malformed-content test
checklist.description: test_config_utils.py includes a test that verifies parse_config raises an error when given a file with content that cannot be parsed as valid INI (e.g., a file whose first non-comment line is not a section header)

checklist.name: Boundary condition test
checklist.description: test_config_utils.py includes at least one test for a boundary condition: an empty file, a file containing unicode characters in section or key names, or a file with only comments and no sections

checklist.name: Specific assertions
checklist.description: All assertions in test_config_utils.py are specific (e.g., assert result == {...} or assert result["key"] == "value") — no bare assert result or assert result is not None used as the sole check

checklist.name: Red commit before green
checklist.description: WORKFLOW.md git log shows the tests commit appearing earlier in the sequence than the implementation commit

checklist.name: Linter evidence
checklist.description: WORKFLOW.md records that a linter or type-checker was run (e.g., flake8, pylint, or mypy) and shows the command or its output

checklist.name: Test file isolation
checklist.description: Tests in test_config_utils.py use pytest's tmp_path or tmpdir fixture (or equivalent) to create temporary INI files, rather than hardcoded paths or module-level global state

checklist.name: Separate test and code commits
checklist.description: WORKFLOW.md git log shows the test file and the implementation file in separate commits — not combined in one commit
